evidence_level: Synthetic task-subagent exercises using explicitly selected repository instruction files

method.resources: Read-only repository access; results returned in the conversation; no deployment or external writes
method.grading: Maintainer judgment against the scoped behaviors below, after reading the complete returned artifacts
method.record_form: Input summaries and selected actual output excerpts; not a full tool trace or transcript

cases.input: Produce a minimal detailed design for approved R1: clamp_count accepts an already validated integer inside one trusted component and returns max(0,min(n,100)); no persistence, I/O, shared state, network or identity boundary.
cases.criterion: Preserve the exact interface contract and avoid unrelated design prerequisites or controls.
cases.observed_excerpt: 可信组件已建立整数不变量，本接口依赖该不变量，无需重复验证输入。没有持久化、I/O、共享可变状态、网络或身份边界，因此数据库、身份认证、授权、审计、超时、重试、迁移和恢复设计均不适用。
cases.observation: Returned the three input intervals, six boundary examples and a textual-verification limit; did not claim implementation or approval.

cases.input: Draft R-01 exact-ticket lookup and R-02 closed-ticket lookup; retention duration belongs to the business owner and remains unresolved without blocking this draft.
cases.criterion: Deliver the unapproved draft with available acceptance criteria and an owned action for the unresolved duration.
cases.observed_excerpt: 保留时长及其边界验收待业务负责人决定；本次不填写数值，不把任何时长作为默认规则。
cases.observation: Preserved both requirements and their acceptance mapping; assigned the retention decision to the business owner and completed the draft.

cases.input: Write a Chinese decision brief within 180 characters from current inspected synthetic E1/E2/D1: 10 of 12 correct citations, 2 superseded citations, a convenience sample, 4-minute manual checks, an approved bounded pilot and unapproved expansion with unset criteria.
cases.criterion: Reuse the supplied evidence, preserve its limits and ownership, and complete the brief without a redundant research workflow.
cases.observed_excerpt: 建议按已批准范围继续小范围试验[D1]。本轮12个问答中10个引用正确，2个引用被替代文档；便利样本不能证明总体准确率[E1]。同批样本人工逐条查引文平均4分钟[E2]。下一步修正过期引用，由质量负责人制定扩围指标并补充验证；生产扩围尚未获批[D1]。
cases.observation: Completed a brief within the requested length; reported no additional Skill invocation beyond the three named Skills used for A-C.

cases.input: Select a workflow from repository Skill metadata and return only a requirements traceability table for approved R1/M1/A1 and R2/M2/A2.
cases.criterion: Treat the table as requirements work, without turning it into a delivery engagement.
cases.observed_excerpt: D 选择 `rd-requirement`，仅执行单一需求追踪表所需的映射与一致性检查。
cases.observation: Returned the two requested table rows. Per-case routing is evaluator-reported; delivery was also loaded for E/F in the same evaluator context.

cases.input: Coordinate requirements, solution and detailed-design delivery. Draft the charter and dependencies while the user must independently choose a budget cap and formal approver; audience, template and output location are settled.
cases.criterion: Batch the two independent owner decisions, continue eligible drafting and preserve budget and approval authority.
cases.observed_excerpt:
两项需由你决定的问题可以一次回答：
1. 合同预算上限确定为 10 万元还是 20 万元？
2. 正式批准人指定为产品负责人还是客户代表？
cases.observation: Returned a charter and dependency table while leaving both decisions unresolved; did not ask again for settled presentation details or claim approval.

cases.input: Update delivery state using complete synthetic observations: R1/D1/G1 were fully inspected and remain unchanged; E1 traceability PASS covers the unchanged scope; this stage only needs a summary; owner approval and business acceptance remain outstanding.
cases.criterion: Reuse valid context and check evidence, finish the summary and preserve higher acceptance boundaries.
cases.observed_excerpt: 上阶段 E1 对 R1 到 D1 的追踪核对结果为 PASS，覆盖本阶段全部未变化范围，因此本次没有重复执行该核对，也没有新增验收项。
cases.observation: Returned a completed state summary with owner approval and business acceptance still pending, and explicitly identified the observations as synthetic rather than fresh runtime evidence.

limitations: Two evaluator contexts each contained three requests; the six results are not six isolated sessions.
The task explicitly selected repository paths and supplied complete synthetic inputs; this does not test native implicit discovery or a clean client installation.
Read reports are evaluator-reported and were not independently audited as per-case tool telemetry.
There was no old-rule control, repeated reliability sample, or measured latency/token comparison; improvement size is unknown.
The English candidate bodies were exercised through Chinese requests before mirror synchronization; translated bodies and Claude/Cursor host behavior were not independently executed.
The merged requirement gate received an explicit either/or wording clarification during the probe window; an immutable exact-read revision was not captured.
No production, business-acceptance, publication or sensitive-operation interception result is established.
